styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean off-white #F2F0F4 or pure white #FFFFFF for packshot and spec screens; one signature electric gradient panel #5B2EE5 to #E100D9 reserved for benefit, structure and CTA screens; real outdoor trail only for lifestyle
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, controlled specular highlights on the lens, cool neutral 5500K in lifestyle
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-grey studio sweep #F2F0F4 and closed hard shell case #1C1C1E as prop surface
styleLock.typography: modern italic geometric sans-serif, bold condensed Chinese headlines 28-48pt, subtitles 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line white icons inside thin white circles, single weight, no filled cartoon icons
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the product across the set, glasses always shown with lens coating readable
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent sporty high-energy cycling gear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean off-white #F2F0F4, pure white #FFFFFF, near-black text #1A1A1E, one electric purple accent #5B2EE5 and one magenta accent #E100D9 used only together as the gradient panel or as icon accents; cool temperature with bright soft studio lighting, front-left key, soft contact shadows; modern italic geometric sans-serif bold condensed headlines 28-48pt, subtitles 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt; consistent thin-line white icons inside thin white circles; crisp commercial product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale with balanced composition margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
shots.camera: slight 3/4 front view at eye level, glasses with arms folded, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Centered slight 3/4 front view at eye level, glasses with arms folded, full product visible, not clipped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product fills 50-60% of the frame, centered with even balanced margins on all sides. 8K, commercial cycling gear ecommerce quality. Negative: no props, no case, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no colored background, no gradient background, no cut-off edges.

shots.lighting: soft studio key from front-left with a subtle accent rim on the lens, soft contact shadow
shots.props: closed hard shell case #1C1C1E under the product
shots.textZone: top-left one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF; a row of four thin-line white circle icons with short labels 「{selling_point_1}」 「{selling_point_2}」 「{selling_point_3}」 「{selling_point_4}」

shots.intent: 放大骑行中风沙、碎屑与炫目晃眼的痛点，引出护目解法
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, straight-on, identical camera and crop on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel harsh flat glare light with dust haze; right panel soft clean studio light
shots.background: left panel hazy light grey #D8D8DC with wind streaks; right panel clean white #FFFFFF
shots.props: abstract dust particles and motion streaks on the left panel only
shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 on the left and 「{callout_2}」 on the right, both in #1A1A1E
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen for {product}, two matched panels with identical straight-on framing and crop. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Left panel: abstract wind streaks, dust particles and harsh glare haze over light grey #D8D8DC conveying eyes exposed to wind and debris, no person shown. Right panel: {product} resting calmly on clean white #FFFFFF in soft studio light conveying clear protected vision. The product fills 50-60% of each panel with balanced margins. Each panel carries one short label 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #1A1A1E. Negative: no real rider face, no fabricated statistics or claims, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no gloved hands.

shots.intent: 低角度跟拍代入真实骑行场景，产品在佩戴中证明价值
shots.camera: low tracking angle photographed from behind the rider looking slightly upward, rider centered
shots.lighting: natural late-afternoon sunlight 5500K from the upper left, dappled foliage shadow
shots.background: sunlit forest trail with green foliage, natural depth of field
shots.props: trail bike and helmet only, no branded gear
shots.whitespace: natural breathing room from the trail ahead and the soft foliage depth of field
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} worn by a cyclist riding a forest trail, photographed from a low tracking angle from behind the rider looking slightly upward. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Rider shown only from behind, wearing a plain unbranded helmet, face never visible, jersey plain with no logos. Natural late-afternoon sunlight 5500K from the upper left with dappled foliage shadows. Background sunlit forest trail with green foliage and natural depth of field. Short lower-third caption strip 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF. The rider and the product occupy 40-50% of the frame, with the trail ahead and the soft foliage depth of field giving natural breathing room. Negative: no visible face, no brand logos on helmet or jersey, no deformed hands on the handlebar, no extra text, no watermark, no cluttered scene.

shots.intent: 微距镜片镀膜反光证明镜片工艺与质感

shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing the coating sheen, controlled highlight, deep soft falloff
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the curved lens surface and its reflective mirror coating, shot from a high tilted angle. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing the coating sheen, controlled highlight, deep soft falloff. Near-black matte background #141418. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, with only minimal margins because the coating texture itself is the whole point. Negative: no blurry subject, no fingerprints or smudges, no duplicated lens reflections, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.
